topic: Analytics dashboard reporting issues and fixes
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on debugging an issue with the traffic dashboard report. Initially, a user reported that the column names in the report were incorrect or broken when tested under multiple users and accessed via a specific URL.

Troubleshooting involved checking for caching issues (suggesting Ctrl+F5) and verifying the environment. The core issue was identified when one participant added grouping by facility to the report, which successfully reproduced the reported discrepancy.
decisions: The dashboard reporting issue is linked to grouping data by facility.
